description: This file implements runtime power management functions for devices in Zephyr OS, including suspend, resume, enable, disable, and reference counting mechanisms.

methods.name: runtime_suspend
methods.description: Suspends a device, either synchronously or asynchronously, with optional delay.

methods.name: runtime_suspend_work
methods.description: Work handler to perform device suspend asynchronously.

methods.name: get_sync_locked
methods.description: Performs a synchronized resume of a device under interrupt-safe conditions.

methods.name: pm_device_runtime_get
methods.description: Increases device usage count and resumes device if needed.

methods.name: put_sync_locked
methods.description: Performs a synchronized suspend of a device under interrupt-safe conditions.

methods.name: pm_device_runtime_put
methods.description: Decreases device usage count and suspends device if no longer in use.

methods.name: pm_device_runtime_put_async
methods.description: Asynchronously decreases device usage count with delay.

methods.name: pm_device_runtime_auto_enable
methods.description: Automatically enables runtime PM if auto flag is set.

methods.name: runtime_enable_sync
methods.description: Synchronously enables runtime PM for a device.

methods.name: pm_device_runtime_enable
methods.description: Enables runtime PM for a device.

methods.name: runtime_disable_sync
methods.description: Synchronously disables runtime PM for a device.

methods.name: pm_device_runtime_disable
methods.description: Disables runtime PM for a device.

methods.name: pm_device_runtime_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if runtime PM is enabled for a device.
